in_hebrew.name: חֶסֶכ
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Hescock is derived from the Hebrew word חֶסֶכ (cheshek), which means grace, kindness, or favor. In the Bible, this name is not explicitly mentioned, but the concept of God's grace and kindness is a recurring theme throughout the scriptures.

in_greek.name: Χεσκώκ
in_greek.meaning: χεστός (chestos) + κωκκός (kokkos) = favor + small round loaf of bread
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Hescock in Greek is derived from the words χεστός (chestos), meaning favor or grace, and κωκκός (kokkos), meaning a small round loaf of bread. This name may have been given to someone who was particularly kind or generous, and it serves as a reminder of God's grace and provision.

in_latin.name: Hescochus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Hescock in Latin is derived from the name Hesus (Jesus) and the word cock. The word cock in Latin can mean rooster or a round loaf of bread, depending on the context. It is unclear why this name was formed in this way, but it may have been given to someone who was particularly devoted to Jesus or who was known for their kindness and generosity, reminiscent of the shape of a round loaf of bread.
